args: runtime="$COCONET_EXECUTABLE"; if [ -z "$runtime" ]; then data_root="$XDG_DATA_HOME"; if [ -z "$data_root" ]; then data_root="$HOME/.local/share"; fi; runtime="$data_root/coconet/current/bin/coconet"; fi; if [ ! -x "$runtime" ] && command -v coconet >/dev/null 2>&1; then runtime="$(command -v coconet)"; fi; exec "$runtime" mcp --agent claude
